info.title: Unitfield Apps and Websites API
info.description: Immutable app versions, vendor review, business installations and grants, installation webhooks and usage, native extensions, websites and domains. Vendor publishing and review require distinct global roles and a fresh verified AAL2 session without X-Tenant-Id. Business management and staff hosts require current tenant membership and permissions. Public site reads are not in this document: org sites read through the storefront API.
